title: Emerald Spear
description: Introducing a new spear called 'Emerald Spear' with crafting recipe.
body:
**We are introducing a new pure item called "Emerald Spear."**

We know we only have wooden, stone, iron, copper, gold, diamond and netherite spear BUT from this datapack + resource pack you will get another spear which is 'EMERALD SPEAR'!

### IMPORTANT (Download the ResourcePack as well)!!

Go to this link: [Get ResourcePack & DataPack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/emerald-spear/version/1.0)
and scroll down you will see both datapack file and resource pack file, download both then add  the datapack in your world from settings and the resource pack in resoruce packs folder, enjoy:)
